reproducedAndFixed.issue: AppData virtualization under the Windows packaged host redirected C: writes to another volume; logical sibling tempfile persist failed with Windows error 17
reproducedAndFixed.fix: Resolve the existing physical parent before creating and persisting sibling temporary files; applies to imports, shared exports, copy, batch and conversion cache. No-clobber protections retained.
reproducedAndFixed.evidence: Minimal same-dependency probe reproduced CrossesDevices; physical-parent probe succeeded; same public API import changed from IMPORT failure to a committed 4169-byte source and library count 1.

reproducedAndFixed.issue: Packaged CSP rejected blob fetch for a locally selected GLTF BIN attachment
reproducedAndFixed.fix: connect-src permits self/blob/data plus existing IPC; remote model resources are still rejected by the loader, with no new network origin allowed
reproducedAndFixed.evidence: Real GLTF+BIN load emitted connect-src violation before the fix; final packaged WebView loaded the 12-triangle cube, generated 512 blocks and saved a real Bedrock structure with no new console error.

reproducedAndFixed.issue: Litematica metadata always reported zero blocks/volume, used seconds, and named generated library entries null
reproducedAndFixed.fix: Count the resolved encoded grid, excluding all air variants; millisecond timestamps; preserve supplied output name and use filename fallback for historical placeholder names.

Final native 2x2x2 import retained its requested name, DataVersion 3955, TotalVolume 8, TotalBlocks 8 and millisecond timestamp. Added metadata/overlap/air and placeholder-import regression tests.
